title: A unified variational framework for the inverse Kohn-Sham problem
summary: The inverse Kohn-Sham (KS) problem seeks a local effective potential whose noninteracting ground state reproduces a prescribed electron density. Although many inversion formulations and schemes have been developed, they are often formulated in disparate languages, including reduced variational optimization, penalty regularization, response-based iteration, and PDE-constrained optimization. In this work, we develop a unified framework for inverse KS theory in two steps.
